title: H227 design: PEAD-LDA hybrid — add LDA topic features alongside FinBERT score
rationale: Wu et al. (2025) show combining FinBERT sentiment with LDA topic decomposition enhances explanatory R² on announcement-day returns. Our H174 uses FinBERT score + EPS surprise as dual filter. H227 tests adding LDA topic presence as a third filter: high-quality positive FinBERT + surprise + topic profile consistent with beat (e.g., strong revenue/margin topics). This is an incremental upgrade to a confirmed strategy, low-risk hypothesis design.
content: h227_status: QUEUED (2026-05-26) — PEAD-LDA Hybrid: Add LDA topic decomposition (8-topic model from 8-K Item 2.02 corpus) alongside H174 FinBERT score. Hypothesis: stocks with high FinBERT score + positive surprise + dominant 'revenue growth / beat' topic > H174 WR=81.8%. Source: arXiv:2509.24254 Wu et al. ACM ICAIF 2025. Implementation: fit LDA on cached h163_8k_*.txt corpus; assign topic to each filing; add as filter. Run h227 only after H222-full (EDGAR XBRL) completes.
